scope: Real local ledger and support storage. Mocked model transport, database adapter and role identities in unit tests. No live PostgreSQL/provider verification.
checks: Parallel local debits cannot overdraw or lose updates
Every accepted debit has exactly one ledger entry
Invalid debit leaves persisted balance unchanged
Database inserts succeed without writable local disk
Database edits return the persisted row without a local mirror
Successful booking-intent sandbox never writes leads, conversations or calendar events
Sandbox charges the response policy and preserves history
Fallback model receives the conversation history
Unavailable model returns an error without charging or fabricated answers
Rejected debit cannot be reported as a successful paid response
Customer cannot call the administrator reply handler
Customer sees support answer without internal notes
Customer can reopen a closed ticket
